topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Lord above, the rains have come at last, but it’s the talk of little Will that’s churned the earth in my heart. He speaks of Master Halden, the same old stick that shaped my boy’s mind with the same heavy hand that once pressed down on my own. I hear the echo of bygone lessons in his voice, the sharp rap of the ruler, the cold silence after a wrong answer. The land may change, but this valley holds fast to its ways, and I fear for Will, who stands where I once did, under the shadow of a master who sees not the soul but the task. The seed is planted, but what will grow, I do not know.
